findings.evidence: The existing tenant and vendor notification components keep targetHref private and the repository has no app-level notification component test harness. Typechecks and production builds verify compilation and route generation, but not an authenticated click that marks one item read before navigation.
findings.why_it_matters: A build cannot prove the complete browser interaction, identity scoping, or read-state invalidation path for a support item.
findings.required_action: Run the Phase 04 browser acceptance flow with tenant and platform-admin accounts, including unread support selection, SUPPORT filtering, mark-all, polling/focus refresh, and unauthorized-ticket handling.
